celfmt -agent -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

celfmt -extract -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_extract.txt

-- src.cel --
interval: {{interval}}
run_as_cel: true
request.url: {{url}}
{{#if ssl}}
request.ssl: {{ssl}}
{{/if}}
cel.max_executions: {{max_executions}}
cel.state:
  api_token: {{api_token}}
cel.redact:
  fields:
    - api_token
cel.program: |-
  state.with({"Header":{"Accept":["application/json"]}}.as(h, get_request(state.url).with(h).do_request().as(resp, {"events":[{"message":resp.Body.decode_json().encode_json()}],"want_more":false})))
tags:
  - run_as_cel
{{#if processors}}
processors:
{{processors}}
{{/if}}
-- want.txt --
interval: {{interval}}
run_as_cel: true
request.url: {{url}}
{{#if ssl}}
request.ssl: {{ssl}}
{{/if}}
cel.max_executions: {{max_executions}}
cel.state:
  api_token: {{api_token}}
cel.redact:
  fields:
    - api_token
cel.program: |-
  state.with({"Header": {"Accept": ["application/json"]}}.as(h, get_request(state.url).with(h).do_request().as(resp, {"events": [{"message": resp.Body.decode_json().encode_json()}], "want_more": false})))
tags:
  - run_as_cel
{{#if processors}}
processors:
{{processors}}
{{/if}}
-- want_extract.txt --
state.with({"Header": {"Accept": ["application/json"]}}.as(h, get_request(state.url).with(h).do_request().as(resp, {"events": [{"message": resp.Body.decode_json().encode_json()}], "want_more": false})))
